deadline.value: The rounds on the page are for the 2026-2027 academic year, and the page does not give a Fall 2027 start.

also.quote: The autumn 2026 application period is from 2 September 2026 at 08:00 AM EEST until 15 September 2026 at 03:00 PM EEST

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants must have one or more supervisors when they submit the application.
supervisor.quote: The doctoral programme requires applicants to have one or more supervisors at the time of submitting their application

funding.value: First-year funding covering living costs and project costs must be confirmed at the application stage, and the supervisor commits to funding only if no other funding is available.
funding.quote: Funding for the first year, beginning on the start date of the study right

also.quote: The supervisor commits to funding the doctoral researcher's project and living expenses for at least one year if no other funding is available

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold a second-cycle (master's) degree or an equivalent foreign qualification.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have completed one of the following: | An applicable second-cycle (master's) degree

notes: Key research areas include molecular neuroscience, so neuro is listed here. Target degrees are offered by the Faculty of Medicine, Faculty of Biological and Environmental Sciences, Faculty of Pharmacy and Faculty of Veterinary Medicine. The page admits once in autumn and once in spring; the autumn 2026 round has closed, so the only upcoming date is 12-25 January 2027.
